caption: The drawing is on a plain beige or light tan background. Near the upper center of the page, there is a small, simple line drawing of an object that appears to be a semi-circular or half-oval shape with horizontal lines at the base, resembling a dome with a base or a closed cloche. The lines of the drawing are black and thin. Below this, in the lower half of the page and slightly to the right of center, there is a small irregular brownish-orange stain. The rest of the page is empty with no additional ornamentation or objects.
